**任务：** 稠密矩阵乘 / 卷积，CUDA 上有哪些官方加速库（cuBLAS / cuDNN / cuSPARSE）？怎么选怎么调用。

**仅凭已有知识给出的完整回答：**

## 1. 库的定位与选择

- **cuBLAS**：NVIDIA 官方 BLAS（Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms）实现，专门做**稠密矩阵乘（GEMM）**，即 `C = α·op(A)·op(B) + β·C`。支持的精度：FP64 / FP32 / TF32 / FP16 / BF16 / INT8（部分）以及 FP8（新架构）。核心入口是 `cublasSgemm`（FP32）、`cublasDgemm`（FP64）、`cublasGemmEx`（混合精度/多类型统一入口）、以及 `cublasLtMatmul`（cuBLASLt 轻量级高级 API，支持 epilogue 融合、更大调优空间）。
- **cuDNN**：NVIDIA 官方深度神经网络原语库，做**卷积（convolution）**、池化、归一化、激活、RNN/attention 等。卷积入口是 `cudnnConvolutionForward`，配合 `cudnnConvolutionDescriptor_t`、`cudnnFilterDescriptor_t`、`cudnnTensorDescriptor_t`、算法选择 `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm_v7` / `cudnnFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithmEx`（后者会实际 benchmark）。新版本还推出 **cuDNN Frontend (Graph API)**，以图方式融合 conv+bias+act。
- **cuSPARSE**：NVIDIA 官方稀疏线性代数库，做**稀疏矩阵**运算（SpMM、SpMV、SpGEMM 等）。**它不是稠密 GEMM 库**；只有在矩阵高度稀疏、且能用 CSR/COO/BSR 等格式表达时才考虑。对"稠密矩阵乘"，它是错误工具；但 cuSPARSE 里有 `cusparseSDDMM`（采样稠密×稠密→稀疏）和稠密-稀疏混合场景，可作补充。

## 2. 选择决策

| 场景 | 推荐 |
| --- | --- |
| 单个/少量大稠密 GEMM，通用 | cuBLAS `cublasGemmEx` / `cublasLtMatmul` |
| 需要 epilogue 融合（bias/GELU/residual）、批处理 strided/batched GEMM | cuBLASLt |
| 小矩阵批量（batched） | cuBLAS `cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx` |
| 直接卷积、前向/反向、训练/推理 DNN | cuDNN（`cudnnConvolutionForward` 或 Frontend Graph） |
| 矩阵极其稀疏（nnz 远小于 m×n） | cuSPARSE |
| 用 Tensor Core 极致性能、自定义算子 | CUTLASS（模板库，非本次三库之一，但相关） |

要点：**稠密矩阵乘首选 cuBLAS；卷积首选 cuDNN；cuSPARSE 只处理稀疏。** 选择还取决于：数据类型、是否需要 Tensor Core（TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8）、是否需要融合 epilogue、是否 batched、是否有可用的算法启发式。

## 3. 典型调用流程

**cuBLAS（column-major！）**
```c
cublasHandle_t handle;
cublasCreate(&handle);
const float alpha = 1.0f, beta = 0.0f;
// cublas 列主序；若数据行主序，用 C^T = B^T A^T 技巧或 cublasSetMathMode + CUBLAS_... 
cublasSgemm(handle, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_N,
            m, n, k, &alpha, dA, lda, dB, ldb, &beta, dC, ldc);
cublasDestroy(handle);
```
- 需要 `cudnn`/`cublas` 句柄与 CUDA stream 关联：`cublasSetStream(handle, stream)`。
- 混合精度：`cublasGemmEx(handle, opA, opB, m, n, k, &alpha, A, CUDA_R_16F, lda, B, CUDA_R_16F, ldb, &beta, C, CUDA_R_32F, ldc, CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F, CUBLAS_GEMM_DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP)`。

**cuDNN（前向卷积）**
```c
cudnnHandle_t handle; cudnnCreate(&handle);
cudnnTensorDescriptor_t xDesc, yDesc; cudnnFilterDescriptor_t wDesc; cudnnConvolutionDescriptor_t cDesc;
cudnnSetTensor4dDescriptor(xDesc, CUDNN_TENSOR_NCHW, CUDNN_DATA_FLOAT, N, C, H, W);
cudnnSetFilter4dDescriptor(wDesc, CUDNN_DATA_FLOAT, CUDNN_TENSOR_NCHW, K, C, R, S);
cudnnSetConvolution2dDescriptor(cDesc, pad_h, pad_w, stride_h, stride_w, dil_h, dil_w, CUDNN_CROSS_CORRELATION, CUDNN_DATA_FLOAT);
cudnnConvolutionForward(handle, &alpha, xDesc, x, wDesc, w, cDesc,
                        algo, workspace, wsSize, &beta, yDesc, y);
```
- 算法选择：`cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm_v7`（启发式，快）或 `cudnnFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithmEx`（benchmark，慢但更优）。算法如 `CUDNN_CONVOLUTION_FWD_ALGO_IMPLICIT_PRECOMP_GEMM`、`..._WINOGRAD`、`..._FFT`、`..._IMPLICIT_GEMM`。
- 需要 workspace 大小：`cudnnGetConvolutionForwardWorkspaceSize`。
- 可设置 math type：`cudnnSetConvolutionMathType(cDesc, CUDNN_TENSOR_OP_MATH_ALLOW_CONVERSION)` 以启用 Tensor Core。

**cuSPARSE（稀疏 GEMM）**
```c
cusparseHandle_t handle; cusparseCreate(&handle);
// A 稀疏 CSR，B 稠密
cusparseSpMM(handle, CUSPARSE_OP_N, CUSPARSE_OP_N, &alpha, A, B, &beta, C, ...);
```

## 4. 版本 / 工具链

- 通过 **CUDA Toolkit** 分发（`/usr/local/cuda/lib64` 下 `libcublas.so`、`libcudnn.so`、`libcusparse.so`）。
- cuDNN 从 CUDA 9 起为独立下载包；cuBLAS 随 CUDA Toolkit 提供，也有独立版本。
- 头文件 `cublas_v2.h`、`cudnn.h`、`cusparse.h`。
- Tensor Core 精度：TF32（Ampere+）、FP16/BF16（Volta+ / Ampere+）、FP8（Hopper/Ada）。cuBLAS 里通过 `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32` 等启用。

## 不确定处（检索前无法确定）

1. **当前（2026 年）各库最新版本号、CUDA 版本对应关系**——我不确定最新是 CUDA 12.x 还是 13.x，cuDNN 最新是 9.x 还是更高；具体版本配套表（cuDNN ↔ CUDA ↔ 驱动）需查官方 release notes / support matrix。
2. **cuBLASLt 的完整 epilogue API 细节**（`cublasLtMatmulDescSetAttribute`、`CUBLASLT_EPILOGUE_*` 枚举具体值）。
3. **cuDNN Frontend Graph API 的具体函数签名**（`cudnn_frontend::graph::Graph`、`conv_forward`）——我记得存在但签名细节不确定。
4. **cuSPARSE 是否也提供稠密 fast path**、以及 `cusparseSDDMM` 的签名细节。
5. **新版 cuBLAS 是否引入 `cublasLt` 之外的 block-scaled FP8/FP4 API**，以及 Blackwell 相关的新库（如 cuBLAS 对 MXFP 的支持）。
6. **能力/算力要求**：不同 GEMM/conv 算法/精度对 `sm_XX` 的最低要求，我记忆模糊。
7. **官方文档的精确 URL 和章节名**（如 `docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cublas/`、`docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/`），URL 可能已变。

这些不确定项正是需要检索验证的地方。

# cuBLAS 13.4 Documentation — Front Page Analysis

## Page Title & Version Info
- **Document title:** `1. Introduction — cuBLAS 13.4 documentation`
- **Header/branding:** "cuBLAS — The API Reference guide for cuBLAS, the CUDA Basic Linear Algebra Subroutine library."
- **Version:** `v13.4` | PDF available (`../pdf/CUBLAS_Library.pdf`) | Archive link to CUDA Toolkit archive
- **Logo:** NVIDIA CUDA logo with link to contents

---

## Navigation Structure (Front Page / Table of Contents)

The TOC reveals the full documentation layout. Key sections relevant to your request:

**1. Introduction**
- 1.1 Data Layout
- 1.2 New and Legacy cuBLAS API
- 1.3 Example Code
- 1.4 Forward Compatibility
- 1.5 Floating Point Emulation (BF16x9, Fixed-Point, Default Configs, Special Values)

**2. Using the cuBLAS API**
- 2.1 General Description (Error Status, Context, Thread Safety, Reproducibility, Scalars, Streams, Batching, Static Library, GEMM Algorithms Numerical Behavior, Tensor Core Usage, CUDA Graphs, 64-bit Interface)
- 2.2 cuBLAS Datatypes Reference (…, `cublasGemmAlgo_t`, `cublasMath_t`, `cublasComputeType_t`, `cublasEmulationStrategy_t`)
- 2.3 CUDA Datatypes Reference (`cudaDataType_t`, `cudaEmulationStrategy_t`, etc.)
- 2.4 Helper Function Reference (e.g., `cublasCreate()`, `cublasSetStream()`, `cublasSetWorkspace()`, `cublasSetMathMode()`)
- **2.5 Level-1 Function Reference** (axpy, dot, nrm2, scal, etc.)
- **2.6 Level-2 Function Reference** (gemv, ger, symv, trsv, etc.)
- **2.7 Level-3 Function Reference** (gemm, gemm3m, gemmBatched, gemmStridedBatched, gemmGroupedBatched, symm, syrk, trmm, trsm, etc.)
- **2.8 BLAS-like Extension** (geam, dgmm, getrfBatched, gemmEx, cublasGemmEx, cublasGemmBatchedEx, cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx, cublasGemmGroupedBatchedEx, Nrm2Ex, AxpyEx, DotEx, RotEx, ScalEx)

**3. Using the cuBLASLt API**
- 3.1 General Description (Problem Size Limitations, Heuristics Cache, Logging, Narrow Precision Data Types — FP8/FP4 scaling, Batch Invariance, Disabling CPU Instructions)
- 3.2 Code Examples
- 3.3 Datatypes Reference (`cublasLtMatmulDesc_t`, `cublasLtEpilogue_t`, `cublasLtComputeType`, etc.)
- **3.4 API Reference** — includes `cublasLtMatmul()`, `cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic()`, `cublasLtMatmulDescCreate()`, `cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate()`, etc.

**4. Using the cuBLASXt API** (multi-GPU / hybrid CPU-GPU tiling)
**5. Using the cuBLASDx API** (not shipped with CUDA Toolkit)
**6. Using the cuBLAS Legacy API** (deprecated)
**7–10.** Fortran Bindings, Interaction with Other Libraries, Acknowledgements, Notices

---

## The Four cuBLAS APIs (Body Text, §1 Introduction)

The cuBLAS library "exposes four sets of APIs":
- **cuBLAS API** — the main API (since CUDA 6.0)
- **cuBLASXt API** — multi-GPU/host dispatch (since CUDA 6.0)
- **cuBLASLt API** — lightweight GEMM-focused API (since CUDA 10.1)
- **cuBLASDx API** — not shipped with the CUDA Toolkit

---

## Dense Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) Routines

### Standard cuBLAS Level-3 GEMM entry points (§2.7 / §2.8)
| Function | Notes |
|---|---|
| `cublas<t>gemm()` | Core GEMM (typed) — §2.7.1 |
| `cublas<t>gemm3m()` | 3M (Gaussian complexity reduction) — §2.7.2 |
| `cublas<t>gemmBatched()` | Batched GEMM — §2.7.3 |
| `cublas<t>gemmStridedBatched()` | Strided batched GEMM — §2.7.4 |
| `cublas<t>gemmGroupedBatched()` | Grouped batched GEMM — §2.7.5 |
| `cublas<t>gemmEx()` | Extended-precision typed GEMM — §2.8.11 |
| `cublasGemmEx()` | Extended GEMM with explicit types — §2.8.12 |
| `cublasGemmBatchedEx()` | Batched Ex — §2.8.13 |
| `cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx()` | Strided batched Ex — §2.8.14 |
| `cublasGemmGroupedBatchedEx()` | Grouped batched Ex — §2.8.15 |

The user explicitly mentioned **`cublasSgemm`** and **`cublasGemmEx`**: `cublasSgemm` is the single-precision typed form of `cublas<t>gemm()`; `cublasGemmEx` is the generic extended entry point listed at §2.8.12. Related extension GEMMs for complex Hermitian rank-k: `cublasCsyrkEx`, `cublasCsyrk3mEx`, `cublasCherkEx`, `cublasCherk3mEx` (§2.8.16–2.8.19).

### cuBLASLt GEMM entry point
- **`cublasLtMatmul()`** — §3.4.17, the core cuBLASLt matrix-multiply. cuBLASLt is described as "a lightweight library dedicated to GEneral Matrix-to-matrix Multiply (GEMM) operations with a new flexible API," adding "flexibility in matrix data layouts, input types, compute types, and also in choosing the algorithmic implementations and heuristics through parameter programmability." Supports plan creation + reuse (analogous to cuFFT/FFTW).
- Supporting heuristic/algo calls: `cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic()` (§3.4.23), `cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristicForStream()` (§3.4.24).

---

## Precision & Tensor Core Options

### Tensor Core Usage (§2.1.11)
- Tensor cores introduced with Volta (compute capability **7.0+**).
- Since **cuBLAS 11.0.0**, the library "may automatically make use of Tensor Core capabilities wherever possible, unless explicitly disabled by selecting pedantic compute modes."
- Alignment requirements for best Tensor Core performance (must all be satisfied):
  - `((op_A == CUBLAS_OP_N ? m : k) * AtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `((op_B == CUBLAS_OP_N ? k : n) * BtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `(m * CtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `(lda * AtypeSize) % 16 == 0`, `(ldb * BtypeSize) % 16 == 0`, `(ldc * CtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `intptr_t(A) % 16 == 0`, `intptr_t(B) % 16 == 0`, `intptr_t(C) % 16 == 0`
- **FP8** requires these optimal alignment conditions; beyond FP8, **no restrictions** on dimensions/alignment since cuBLAS 11.0.0.

### Math modes — `cublasMath_t` (`cublasSetMathMode()`, §2.2.10)
- `CUBLAS_DEFAULT_MATH` — default, highest performance; Tensor Cores used whenever possible.
- `CUBLAS_PEDANTIC_MATH` — prescribed precision/standardized arithmetic; less performant.
- **`CUBLAS_TF32_TENSOR_OP_MATH`** — enables TF32 tensor cores; input conversions round to nearest even.
- `CUBLAS_FP32_EMULATED_BF16X9_MATH` — BF16x9 emulation (uses `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_EMULATED_16BFX9`).
- `CUBLAS_FP64_EMULATED_FIXEDPOINT_MATH` — fixed-point emulation for FP64.
- `CUBLAS_MATH_DISALLOW_REDUCED_PRECISION_REDUCTION` — bitwise-OR flag forcing reductions in compute type.
- `CUBLAS_TENSOR_OP_MATH` — **deprecated**.

### Compute types — `cublasComputeType_t` (§2.2.11, used by `cublasGemmEx`/`cublasLtMatmul`)
Relevant to your TF32/FP16/BF16 question:
- `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F` / `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F_PEDANTIC` — half precision
- `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F` / `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_PEDANTIC`
- **`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16F`** — Tensor Cores with 16-bit half-precision compute
- **`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16BF`** — Tensor Cores with bfloat16 compute
- **`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32`** — Tensor Cores with TF32 compute (inputs round to nearest even)
- `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_EMULATED_16BFX9` — BF16x9 emulation
- `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_64F` / `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_64F_EMULATED_FIXEDPOINT` / `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_64F_PEDANTIC`
- `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32I` / `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32I_PEDANTIC` — integer
- **Note:** `NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE = 0` disables TF32 acceleration in cuBLAS regardless of other settings.

### Data types — `cudaDataType_t` (§2.3.1)
Includes `CUDA_R_16F`/`CUDA_C_16F`, `CUDA_R_16BF`/`CUDA_C_16BF`, `CUDA_R_32F`/`CUDA_C_32F`, `CUDA_R_64F`/`CUDA_C_64F`, integer types, plus FP8 `CUDA_R_8F_E4M3`, `CUDA_R_8F_E5M2`, and FP4 `CUDA_R_4F_E2M1`.

---

## CUDA / Version Requirements

- **Forward compatibility (§1.4):** cuBLAS works on future GPUs generally via PTX JIT, but no performance guarantees, and **limited forward compatibility for narrow precisions (FP4, FP8) and tiled 8-bit integer layouts.**

### Floating Point Emulation support (§1.5.1–1.5.2)
| Algorithm | Emulates | Supported compute capabilities | CUDA Version |
|---|---|---|---|
| **BF16x9** | FP32 | 10.0, 10.3 | **12.9+** |
| **Fixed-Point** | FP64 | 8.x, 9.0, 10.x, 11.0, 12.x | **13.0u2+** |

- FP emulation first introduced in **CUDA 12.9**.
- **BF16x9:** only gives a speed advantage when peak BF16 throughput > 9× peak FP32 throughput; requires special hardware for scaling — thus supported only on select architectures.
- **Fixed-Point:** based on Ozaki-I and Ozaki-II schemes; workspace never exceeds **8 GB**.

### Workspace sizing (§2.4.8)
| GPU Architecture | Recommended workspace |
|---|---|
| Hopper and newer (sm90+) | 32 MiB |
| Other | 4 MiB |

- ≥16 KiB prevents `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED`; larger helps performance.
- Static library (`libcublas_static.a`) available on Linux (depends on `libculibos.a`). Since release **11.2**, using typed functions instead of `cublas**Ex()` reduces static-library binary size.

---

## Key Supporting Notes

- **Data Layout (§1.1):** column-major storage, 1-based indexing; macros `IDX2F(i,j,ld)` (Fortran) and `IDX2C(i,j,ld)` (C/C++).
- **New vs Legacy API (§1.2):** new API via `cublas_v2.h` (handle-based, alpha/beta by reference, `cublasStatus_t` returns). **Legacy API is deprecated and will be removed**; use `cublas.h`. Both headers cannot be mixed in one translation unit.
- **Reproducibility (§2.1.4):** bit-wise reproducible per toolkit version on same-architecture GPUs with same SM count; not guaranteed across toolkit versions or with multiple streams / fixed-point emulation.
- **64-bit integer interface (§2.1.13):** `_64` suffix variants change dimensions/leading dims/increments from `int` to `int64_t` (e.g., `cublasSsyr_64`).
- **Example code (§1.3):** two full C examples using `cublas_v2.h` (1-based and 0-based indexing), using `cublasCreate`, `cublasSetMatrix`, `cublasSscal`, `cublasGetMatrix`, `cublasDestroy`.

---

### Summary of What You Asked For
| Item | Finding |
|---|---|
| **Title** | "1. Introduction — cuBLAS 13.4 documentation" |
| **Version** | cuBLAS v13.4 |
| **GEMM routines** | `cublas<t>gemm`, `gemm3m`, `gemmBatched`, `gemmStridedBatched`, `gemmGroupedBatched`; extended: `cublas<t>gemmEx`, `cublasGemmEx`, `cublasGemmBatchedEx`, `cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx`, `cublasGemmGroupedBatchedEx`; cuBLASLt: `cublasLtMatmul` |
| **TF32** | `CUBLAS_TF32_TENSOR_OP_MATH` math mode; `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32` compute type; disabled via `NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0` |
| **FP16** | `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16F`; `CUDA_R_16F`; `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F` |
| **BF16** | `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16BF`; `CUDA_R_16BF`; BF16x9 emulation `CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_EMULATED_16BFX9` |
| **Tensor Core reqs** | CC 7.0+; auto-used since cuBLAS 11.0.0; 16-byte alignment conditions listed above |
| **CUDA requirements** | Emulation needs CUDA 12.9+ (BF16x9) / 13.0u2+ (fixed-point); APIs span CUDA 6.0+ (cuBLAS, cuBLASXt), 10.1+ (cuBLASLt) |

# cuDNN Backend API Overview — Extraction Report

## 1. Title
**"Backend API Overview — NVIDIA cuDNN Backend"**

## 2. Version
- **Page context:** NVIDIA cuDNN **Backend API**, "latest" (v9 backend documentation).
- **Library version discussed:** **cuDNN version 9**, reorganized into sub-libraries.
- **Most recent API change entry listed:** **cuDNN 9.21.0**
- **Version history spans:** 9.0.0 → 9.21.0 (with mention of legacy v7/v8 functionality).

## 3. Navigation / Structure (Nav)
The page has two top-level sections:

**A. Backend API Overview** — describes the context-based API, the v9 library split, and the per-library breakdown:
- `cudnn_graph` (`libcudnn_graph.so`) — context creation/destruction, backend descriptors, attributes; loads engine libraries via `dlopen`.
- `cudnn_ops` — legacy tensor descriptor management, tensor utilities, common ML algorithms (batch norm, softmax, dropout).
- `cudnn_cnn` — legacy convolutional neural network APIs.
- `cudnn_adv` — RNNs, CTC loss, multihead attention.

**B. Added, Deprecated, and Removed APIs** — chronological subsections:
- 9.21.0, 9.20.0, 9.15.0, 9.14.0, 9.13.0, 9.8.0, 9.5.0, 9.2.0, 9.1.0, 9.0.0
- Plus a "Removed 9.0.0 APIs" table.

*(Note: there is a single architecture image reference: `ovr-arch.png`.)*

## 4. Body — Direct Responses to Your Queries

### ⚠️ Difference between Backend API and Frontend API
**Important limitation:** This page does **not** explicitly define or contrast a "frontend API" vs a "backend API." The term "frontend API" does **not appear** anywhere in the provided content. What the page *does* provide is a contrast between **legacy/imperative APIs** and the **graph/backend API**:

| Aspect | Legacy (pre-v9 / "imperative") | Graph API / Backend ("declarative") |
|---|---|---|
| Introduced | cuDNN v7 and older | cuDNN v8 |
| Style | Fixed set of operations & fusion patterns | Declarative (graph-based) |
| Library | `libcudnn_cnn.so`, `libcudnn_ops.so`, `libcudnn_adv.so`, shim `libcudnn.so` | `libcudnn_graph.so` |
| Access | Directly usable | Recommended path |

> Direct quote: *"This new library structure separates legacy functionality (an imperative API with a fixed set of operations and fusion patterns in cuDNN version 7 and older) from the graph API (a declarative API, introduced in cuDNN version 8), as well as from the engine implementation."*

**Interpretation:** The "backend API" in this documentation refers to the **cuDNN backend** (context/descriptor-based, graph-oriented API tied to `libcudnn_graph.so`), as distinguished from the legacy imperative frontend-style calls. No explicit "frontend API" definition is given on this page.

---

### Convolution API Entry Points
Content on convolution entry points is spread across the page (headers, the deprecation list, and the removal table). Findings:

**Convolution functions that appear:**
- `cudnnConvolutionForward()` — listed under **Deprecated APIs (cuDNN 9.0.0)**, linking to `cudnn-cnn-library.html#cudnnconvolutionforward`.
- `cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward()` — listed under **Deprecated APIs (cuDNN 9.0.0)**, linking to `cudnn-cnn-library.html#cudnnconvolutionbiasactivationforward`.
- `cudnnConvolutionBackwardData()`, `cudnnConvolutionBackwardFilter()`, `cudnnConvolutionBackwardBias()` — also deprecated (9.0.0).

**Convolution descriptors:**
- `cudnnCreateConvolutionDescriptor()` / `cudnnDestroyConvolutionDescriptor()` — deprecated (9.0.0).
- Setters/getters deprecated: `cudnnSetConvolution2dDescriptor()`, `cudnnGetConvolution2dDescriptor()`, `cudnnSetConvolutionNdDescriptor()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionNdDescriptor()`, `cudnnSetConvolutionGroupCount()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionGroupCount()`, `cudnnSetConvolutionMathType()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionMathType()`, `cudnnSetConvolutionReorderType()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionReorderType()`.
- 2D dimension helpers: `cudnnGetConvolution2dForwardOutputDim()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionNdForwardOutputDim()` (deprecated).
- Types deprecated: `cudnnConvolutionDescriptor_t`, `cudnnConvolutionFwdAlgoPerf_t`, `cudnnConvolutionBwdDataAlgoPerf_t`, `cudnnConvolutionBwdFilterAlgoPerf_t`.

**Algorithm selection:**
- `cudnnFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithm()` / `...Ex()` — deprecated.
- `cudnnFindConvolutionBackwardDataAlgorithm()` / `...Ex()` — deprecated.
- `cudnnFindConvolutionBackwardFilterAlgorithm()` / `...Ex()` — deprecated.
- `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm_v7()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithmMaxCount()`, `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardWorkspaceSize()` — deprecated.
- `cudnnGetConvolutionBackwardDataAlgorithm_v7()`, `...AlgorithmMaxCount()`, `...WorkspaceSize()` — deprecated.
- `cudnnGetConvolutionBackwardFilterAlgorithm_v7()`, `...AlgorithmMaxCount()`, `...WorkspaceSize()` — deprecated.

**Other convolution-related (deprecated):** `cudnnCreateFilterDescriptor()`, `cudnnSetFilter4dDescriptor()`, `cudnnGetFilter4dDescriptor()`, `cudnnIm2Col()`, `cudnnReorderFilterAndBias()`, `cudnnTransformFilter()`, fused-ops plans (`cudnnCreateFusedOpsPlan`, `cudnnMakeFusedOpsPlan`, etc.).

> **Key takeaway:** All named convolution entry points and algorithm-selection APIs are **deprecated as of cuDNN 9.0.0**. This page links them into the `cudnn-cnn-library` and `cudnn-ops-library` pages, but **does not detail their signatures or replacement graph-API equivalents** — those are on the linked sub-library pages.

---

### Guidance on Choosing Backend vs Frontend
The page provides the following explicit recommendation:

> *"We recommend users to make API calls through the graph API, but the older shim layer (`libcudnn.so`) and legacy libraries (`libcudnn_cnn.so`, `libcudnn_ops.so`, `libcudnn_adv.so`) can still be directly used."*

**Additional design rationale quoted:**
- The split provides *"more flexibility on the user side in loading libraries."*
- Engines are separated so that *"in a future version of cuDNN, provide a way for the user to only load the functionality they need, and thus provide an opportunity to save memory and disk space."*
- Engine libraries (`cudnn_engines_precompiled`, `cudnn_heuristics`, `cudnn_engines_runtime_compiled`) *"contain necessary internal functionality to support the aforementioned sub-libraries"* and are loaded via `dlopen` by `cudnn_graph`.

**Dependency notes (for choosing which libraries to load):**
- `cudnn_ops` depends on `cudnn_graph` (and indirectly on `cudnn_engines_precompiled`).
- `cudnn_cnn` depends on `cudnn_ops` and `cudnn_graph`; `cudnn_engines_precompiled` must be present for `cudnn_cnn` to load correctly.
- `cudnn_adv` depends on `cudnn_ops` and `cudnn_graph`.

**Verdict:** The page's sole explicit guidance is to **prefer the graph (backend) API**, while legacy frontend-style calls remain usable but are heavily deprecated.

# cuSPARSE Documentation Analysis

## Summary

The page is the **Introduction chapter (Sections 1–5)** of NVIDIA's cuSPARSE 13.4 documentation — the API reference for the CUDA sparse matrix library. Below are the extracted details matching your request. **Note:** The page covers sparse matrix operations and formats extensively, but contains **no mention of cuBLAS or dense GEMM** being delegated to another library.

---

## Title & Version

- **Title:** "1. Introduction — cuSPARSE 13.4 documentation"
- **Subtitle:** "The API reference guide for cuSPARSE, the CUDA sparse matrix library."
- **Version:** **cuSPARSE 13.4** (as stated in the browser/page title)
- **Related versioning detail:** The library uses `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.BUILD` convention. Version fields increment for: MAJOR = API breaking changes / new CUDA major version; MINOR = new APIs; PATCH = bug fixes or performance improvements; BUILD = internal build number.

---

## What It Does (Operations)

cuSPARSE is a set of **GPU-accelerated basic linear algebra subroutines for sparse matrices**, built on the CUDA runtime and callable from C and C++. **Targets matrices with sparsity ratios between 70%–99.9%**, and performs "significantly faster than CPU-only alternatives."

### Supported Routine Categories
| Operand Combination | Operations |
|---|---|
| sparse vector ↔ dense vector | sum, dot product, scatter, gather |
| dense matrix ↔ sparse vector | multiplication |
| sparse matrix ↔ dense vector | multiplication, triangular solver, tridiagonal solver, pentadiagonal solver |
| sparse matrix ↔ dense matrix | multiplication, triangular solver, tridiagonal solver, pentadiagonal solver |
| sparse matrix ↔ sparse matrix | **sum, multiplication** |
| dense matrices → sparse matrix output | multiplication |
| — | Sparse matrix preconditioners: Incomplete Cholesky (level 0), Incomplete LU (level 0) |
| — | Reordering and conversion between sparse storage formats |

### Specific Named Operations
- **SpMV** (sparse matrix-vector) and **SpMM** (sparse matrix-matrix multiplication) are explicitly named as the most common operations computed by the Generic APIs.
- **SpGEMM** (sparse matrix × sparse matrix multiplication) is covered under "sparse matrix ↔ sparse matrix: multiplication" — though the acronym "SpGEMM" itself does **not** appear verbatim on this page.

---

## Dense Matrix Multiplication

**Dense × dense accumulation into a sparse output is supported** (listed as "Operations between dense matrices with output a sparse matrix: multiplication"). However:

- There is **no statement on this page that "dense GEMM is handled by cuBLAS instead."**
- The only external library references are to **cuSPARSELt** (sparse matrix-matrix multiplication), **nvJitLink** (JIT LTO capability dependency), and standard **CUDA runtime** routines.
- The user's requested note about cuBLAS handling dense GEMM **is not present in this content.**

---

## Supported Sparse Formats

Storage formats are described in **Section 3** (plus format-conversion support). The library supports dense and sparse vectors, and dense and sparse matrices.

| Format | Section | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **COO** (Coordinate) | 3.3.2 | `<row, column>` pairs; assumes sorted by row; supports sorted/unsorted column indices |
| **CSR** (Compressed Sparse Row) | 3.3.3 | Row indices compressed into offsets array; same layout as CSC transpose |
| **CSC** (Compressed Sparse Column) | 3.3.4 | Column indices compressed into offsets array; column-major values |
| **SELL** (Sliced Ellpack) | 3.3.5 | Blocked into slices; padded to max row length (padding = -1); column-major storage |
| **BSR** (Block Sparse Row) | 3.3.6 | Like CSR but column indices reference 2D blocks; only *square* blocks currently supported |
| **BLOCKED-ELL** (Blocked Ellpack) | 3.3.7 | Like Ellpack with block column indices; empty blocks = -1 |
| **BSRX** (Extended BSR) | 3.3.8 | **[DEPRECATED]** BSR with separate `bsrRowPtrA`/`bsrEndPtrA` arrays |

Also covered: **Dense Vector** (3.2.1), **Sparse Vector** (3.2.2), and **Dense Matrix** (3.3.1, row-major / column-major layouts). Index base is selectable via `cusparseIndexBase_t` (zero-based for C, one-based for Fortran).

**Important note on formats:** cuSPARSE routines assume indices are provided in increasing order and that each index appears only once; otherwise correctness "is not always ensured."

---

## Additional Relevant Details

- **Index Base (3.1):** Zero- and one-based indexing supported for C/C++ and Fortran compatibility.
- **Static library (1.2):** `libcusparse_static.a` on Linux since CUDA 6.5.
- **Dependency (1.3):** Since CUDA 12.0, depends on **nvJitLink** for JIT LTO capabilities.
- **Two API sets (1.1):** Legacy APIs (Sparse BLAS-inspired, not improved/enhanced) vs. Generic APIs (standard interface layer, flexible layout/batch/format/type selection).
- **Backward compatibility (2.7):** Source-level backward compatible; not guaranteed at binary level.

---

## Body Text — Key Excerpts

> "The cuSPARSE library contains a set of GPU-accelerated basic linear algebra subroutines used for handling sparse matrices that perform significantly faster than CPU-only alternatives. Depending on the specific operation, the library targets matrices with sparsity ratios in the range between 70%-99.9%."

> "The **Generic APIs** provide the *standard interface layer of cuSPARSE*. They allow computing the most common sparse linear algebra operations, such as sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) and sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM), in a flexible way."

> "Operations between **dense matrices** with output a **sparse matrix**: multiplication"

> "The cuSPARSE library supports dense and sparse vector, and dense and sparse matrix formats."

---

## Gap Note (Answering Your Specific Ask)

✅ **Found:** Version (13.4), purpose, SpMV/SpMM/SpGEMM, supported sparse formats (CSR/COO/CSC/SELL/BSR/BLOCKED-ELL/BSRX), and dense→sparse multiplication.

❌ **Not found on this page:** Any note stating that **dense GEMM is handled by cuBLAS instead** of cuSPARSE. If you need that specific cross-reference, it likely appears in a different section of the cuSPARSE docs, the cuBLAS documentation, or NVIDIA's library comparison/overview pages — not in this Introduction chapter.

**标题**: Graph API — NVIDIA cuDNN Backend

Back to top

# Graph API[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#graph-api "Link to this heading")

For general information about cuDNN graphs, refer to [Graphs](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/developer/graph-api.html#graph-api "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)") in the *Frontend Developer Guide*. Use the cuDNN frontend to access the cuDNN Graph API unless you want to use legacy fixed-function routines or if you need a [C-only graph API](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/cudnn-graph-library.html#cudnn-graph-library).

## Backend Native CUDA Graph API[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#backend-native-cuda-graph-api "Link to this heading")

For general information about the Native CUDA Graph API, refer to [Native CUDA Graph API](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/developer/misc.html#native-cuda-graph-api "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)") in the *Frontend Developer Guide*. Use the cuDNN frontend to access this API unless you want to use legacy fixed-function routines or if you need a C-only interface.

The backend native CUDA graph API consists of two functions:

> - [cudnnBackendPopulateCudaGraph()](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/cudnn-graph-library.html#cudnnbackendpopulatecudagraph)
> - [cudnnBackendUpdateCudaGraph()](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/cudnn-graph-library.html#cudnnbackendupdatecudagraph)

## Specialized Runtime Fusion Engines[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#specialized-runtime-fusion-engines "Link to this heading")

Unless you need a C-only graph API, use the following cuDNN frontend runtime fusion engines:

> - [Fused flash attention fprop](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/developer/graph-api.html#flash-fused-multi-head-att-fprop "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
> - [Fused flash attention bprop](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/developer/graph-api.html#flash-fused-multi-head-att-bprop "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")

### Fused Attention fprop[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#fused-attention-fprop "Link to this heading")

`Mha-Fprop` fusions O=matmul(S=g4(P=matmul(Q,g3(K)),V)) have been added to the runtime fusion engine to serve patterns that are commonly used in attention. These patterns can be used in BERT, T5, and so on.

There are two key differences to the flash fused attention patterns described in later sections:

1. Input sizes supported contain small sequence lengths (<= 512).
2. The operation graph is flexible to switch between different types of masks, different operations between the two matrix multiplications, and so on.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/mha-fprop.png)

g 3 can be an empty graph or a single scale operation with the scale being a scalar value (`CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_POINTWISE_DESCRIPTOR` with mode `CUDNN_POINTWISE_MUL`).

g 4 can be empty or the combination of the following DAGs of cuDNN operations. Each of these DAGs is optional, as shown by the dotted line.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/dag1.png)

The combination has to obey the order in which we present them. For example, if you want to use the padding mask and softmax, the padding mask has to appear before softmax.

These operations are commonly used in attention. In the following diagram, we depict how to create a DAG for each of the operations. In later versions, we will be expanding the possible DAGs for g 3 and g 4.

**Padding Mask**

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/padding-mask.png)

**Causal Mask**

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/dag-causal-mask.png)

**Softmax**

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/softmax.png)

**Dropout**

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/dropout.png)

g 4 is capable of storing an intermediate tensor to global memory marked as `S`, which can be used for fused multi-head attention `bprop`. Both `DAG:Softmax` and `DAG:Dropout` have this capability. Set `S` as the output from the last DAG in the graph.

The tensor descriptor marked as `S` must have the `CUDNN_ATTR_TENSOR_REORDERING_MODE` set to `CUDNN_TENSOR_REORDERING_F16x16`. This is because the tensor is stored in a special format and can only be consumed by fused attention `bprop`.

There is an additional option of generating the mask on the user end and passing it directly to the pointwise multiplier. The mask needs to be of I/O data type FP16/BF16 and `S` will store the mask in the sign bit to communicate to `bprop`.

Limitations Of `Mha-fprop` Fusions[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#id3 "Link to this table")

Limitation

Matmul

- Compute type for both `matmul` ops must be `float`.
- Input tensors must have data type `FP16` or `BF16`.
- Output tensors must have data type `FP16`, `BF16`, or `FP32 (TF32)`.

Pointwise operations in g 3 and g 4

Compute type must be `FP32 (TF32)`.

Reduction operations in g 3 and g 4

I/O types and compute types must be `FP32 (TF32)`.

RNG operation in g 3 and g 4

- Data type of `yTensor` must be `FP32 (TF32)`.
- The `CUDNN_TYPE_RNG_DISTRIBUTION` must be `CUDNN_RNG_DISTRIBUTION_BERNOULLI`.

Layout requirements of `Mha-fprop` fusions include:

> - All I/O tensors must have 4 dimensions, with the first two denoting the batch dimensions. The usage of rank-4 tensors in `matmul` ops can be read from the [Backend Descriptor Types](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/cudnn-graph-library.html#graph-backend-desc-types) documentation.
> - The contracting dimension (dimension `K`) for the first matmul must be 64.
> - The non-contracting dimension (dimensions `M` and `N`) for the first matmul must be less than or equal to 512. In inference mode, any sequence length is functional. For training, support exists only for multiples of 64.
> - The last dimension (corresponding to hidden dimensions) in `Q`, `V`, and `O` is expected to have stride `1`.
> - For the `K` tensor, the stride is expected to be `1` for the 2nd last dimension.
> - The `S` tensor is expected to have `CUDNN_ATTR_TENSOR_REORDERING_MODE` set to `CUDNN_TENSOR_REORDERING_F16x16`.

### Fused Attention bprop[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#fused-attention-bprop "Link to this heading")

`Mha-Bprop` fusions are executed in a fused pattern in a single kernel.

dV=matmul(g5(S),dO) dS=matmul(dO,VT) dQ=matmul(g6(dS),K) dK=matmul(Q,g7(dS))

cuDNN supports the corresponding backpropagation graph for fused attention. This can be used together with the fused attention `fprop` graph to perform training on models that have similar architectures to BERT and T5. This is not compatible with the flash fused attention `bprop` operation graph.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/mha-bprop.png)

g 5, g 6, and g 7 can only support a fixed DAG. We are working towards generalizing these graphs.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/g5.png)

g 6 represents the backward pass of softmax and masking, to get `dP`.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/g6.png)

There are options for the Mask DAG that you can opt-in. You can either use the padding/causal mask, general mask as an input, or not do any masking.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/mask-dag.png)

`dBias` DAG is useful to calculate the `bprop` of the relative positional encoding and is optional and available for you to opt-in.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/dbias-dag.png)

g 7 is the transpose of dP the output of g 6.

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/_images/g7.png)

Limitations Of `Mha-bprop` Fusions[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html#id4 "Link to this table")

Limitation

Matmul

- Compute type for both `matmul` ops must be `float`.
- Input tensors must have data type `FP16` or `BF16`.
- Output tensors must have data type `FP16`, `BF16`, or `FP32 (TF32)`.

Pointwise operations in g 5, g 6, and g 7

Compute type must be `FP32 (TF32)`.

Reduction operations in g 5, g 6, and g 7

I/O types and compute types must be `FP32 (TF32)`.

Layout requirements of `Mha-bprop` fusions include:

> - All I/O tensors must have 4 dimensions, with the first two denoting the batch dimensions. The usage of rank-4 tensors in `matmul` ops can be read from the [Backend Descriptor Types](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/cudnn-graph-library.html#graph-backend-desc-types) documentation.
> - The contracting dimension (dimension `K`) for the second matmul must be 64.
> - The contracting dimension (dimension `K`) for the first, second, and third matmul must be less than or equal to 512 and a multiple of 64.
> - The last dimension (corresponding to hidden dimensions) in `Q`, `K`, `V`, `O`, and `dO` is expected to have stride `1`.
> - The `S` and `dP` tensors are expected to have `CUDNN_ATTR_TENSOR_REORDERING_MODE` set to `CUDNN_TENSOR_REORDERING_F16x16`.

# 稠密矩阵乘 / 卷积的 CUDA 官方加速库：选择与调用

## 一、结论速览（选型）

| 需求 | 官方库 | 入口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 稠密矩阵乘 `C=α·op(A)·op(B)+β·C`（GEMM） | **cuBLAS**（cuBLASLt 子 API） | `cublasGemmEx`、`cublasLtMatmul` |
| 批量 / 卷积化 GEMM、融合 epilogue | **cuBLASLt** | `cublasLtMatmul` + `cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic` |
| 卷积（前向/反向）、池化、归一化、attention | **cuDNN** | Graph API（推荐）；`cudnnConvolutionForward` 系列（**cuDNN 9.0.0 起已废弃**） |
| 稀疏矩阵 × 稠密/稀疏（SpMV/SpMM/SpGEMM） | **cuSPARSE** | Generic API（`cusparseSpMM` 等） |
| 结构化稀疏 × 稠密 | **cuSPARSELt** | 见 cusparselt 文档 |

**关键点：cuSPARSE 不是稠密 GEMM 库。** 官方 cuSPARSE 文档明确其目标是"sparsity ratios in the range between 70%–99.9%"的稀疏矩阵；稠密×稠密的矩阵乘由 cuBLAS 负责。cuSPARSE 只提供"稠密矩阵 → 稀疏矩阵输出"的乘法等混合情形。

## 二、cuBLAS（矩阵乘）

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cublas/index.html （标题 "1. Introduction — cuBLAS 13.4 documentation"，版本 **cuBLAS v13.4**）

官方文档列出 **四套 API**：cuBLAS API（CUDA 6.0 起）、cuBLASXt（多 GPU，CUDA 6.0 起）、cuBLASLt（轻量 GEMM，CUDA 10.1 起）、cuBLASDx（不随 CUDA Toolkit 发布）。

### 稠密 GEMM 入口（§2.7 / §2.8）
- 类型化：`cublas<t>gemm`、`gemm3m`、`gemmBatched`、`gemmStridedBatched`、`gemmGroupedBatched`
- 扩展：`cublas<t>gemmEx`、`cublasGemmEx`（§2.8.12）、`cublasGemmBatchedEx`、`cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx`、`cublasGemmGroupedBatchedEx`
- cuBLASLt：`cublasLtMatmul`（§3.4.17），配合 `cublasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic()`（§3.4.23）、`cublasLtMatmulDescCreate()`、`cublasLtMatrixLayoutCreate()`；支持 plan 创建与复用，可定制 data layout / input type / compute type / 算法启发式。

### 数据类型与计算类型（官方原文枚举）
- `cudaDataType_t`（§2.3.1）：`CUDA_R_16F/C_16F`、`CUDA_R_16BF/C_16BF`、`CUDA_R_32F/C_32F`、`CUDA_R_64F/C_64F`、整型、FP8 `CUDA_R_8F_E4M3` / `CUDA_R_8F_E5M2`、FP4 `CUDA_R_4F_E2M1`
- `cublasComputeType_t`（§2.2.11）：`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_16F`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16F`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16BF`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_TF32`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_EMULATED_16BFX9`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_64F`、`CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32I`
- `cublasMath_t`（§2.2.10，`cublasSetMathMode()`）：`CUBLAS_DEFAULT_MATH`、`CUBLAS_PEDANTIC_MATH`、`CUBLAS_TF32_TENSOR_OP_MATH`（已 deprecated：`CUBLAS_TENSOR_OP_MATH`）、`CUBLAS_FP32_EMULATED_BF16X9_MATH`、`CUBLAS_FP64_EMULATED_FIXEDPOINT_MATH`、`CUBLAS_MATH_DISALLOW_REDUCED_PRECISION_REDUCTION`
- 关闭 TF32：环境变量 `NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE = 0`

### Tensor Core 使用条件（§2.1.11，官方原文）
- Volta（compute capability **7.0+**）引入 Tensor Core。
- 自 **cuBLAS 11.0.0** 起"may automatically make use of Tensor Core capabilities wherever possible, unless explicitly disabled by selecting pedantic compute modes"。
- 最佳 Tensor Core 性能需同时满足 16 字节对齐：
  - `((op_A == CUBLAS_OP_N ? m : k) * AtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `((op_B == CUBLAS_OP_N ? k : n) * BtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `(m * CtypeSize) % 16 == 0`
  - `(lda*AtypeSize)%16==0`、`(ldb*BtypeSize)%16==0`、`(ldc*CtypeSize)%16==0`
  - `intptr_t(A)%16==0`、`intptr_t(B)%16==0`、`intptr_t(C)%16==0`
- FP8 必须满足上述最优对齐；除 FP8 外，自 cuBLAS 11.0.0 起维度/对齐无限制。

### 调用（C 代码骨架；cuBLAS 为列主序 column-major）
```c
#include <cublas_v2.h>
cublasHandle_t handle;
cublasCreate(&handle);
cublasSetStream(handle, stream);          // 关联 CUDA stream

const float alpha = 1.0f, beta = 0.0f;
// C = alpha*op(A)*op(B) + beta*C   （列主序）
cublasSgemm(handle, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_N,
            m, n, k, &alpha,
            dA, lda, dB, ldb, &beta, dC, ldc);
cublasDestroy(handle);
```
混合精度 / Tensor Core（`cublasGemmEx`）：
```c
cublasGemmEx(handle, CUBLAS_OP_N, CUBLAS_OP_N, m, n, k,
             &alpha, dA, CUDA_R_16F, lda,
                     dB, CUDA_R_16F, ldb,
             &beta,  dC, CUDA_R_32F, ldc,
             CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F, CUBLAS_GEMM_DEFAULT_TENSOR_OP);
```
- 数据布局（§1.1）：列主序存储；宏 `IDX2F(i,j,ld)` / `IDX2C(i,j,ld)`。
- 新 API 用 `cublas_v2.h`（handle 式、alpha/beta 传引用、返回 `cublasStatus_t`）；旧 API 已 deprecated 且将移除，两套头文件不可混用于同一编译单元。
- 工作区（§2.4.8）：Hopper 及更新（sm90+）推荐 **32 MiB**，其他 **4 MiB**；≥16 KiB 可避免 `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED`。

## 三、cuDNN（卷积）

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/api/overview.html （cuDNN **9.21.0** 为文档所载最新 API 变更条目，版本历史 9.0.0→9.21.0）；https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/backend/latest/developer/graph-api.html

### 版本 9 的库拆分（官方原文）
> "This new library structure separates legacy functionality (an imperative API with a fixed set of operations and fusion patterns in cuDNN version 7 and older) from the graph API (a declarative API, introduced in cuDNN version 8), as well as from the engine implementation."

- `cudnn_graph`（`libcudnn_graph.so`）— 上下文、backend 描述符、属性；通过 `dlopen` 加载引擎库
- `cudnn_ops`（`libcudnn_ops.so`）— 旧张量描述符、通用算子（batchnorm/softmax/dropout）
- `cudnn_cnn`（`libcudnn_cnn.so`）— 旧卷积 API
- `cudnn_adv`（`libcudnn_adv.so`）— RNN、CTC、多头注意力
- 引擎库：`cudnn_engines_precompiled`、`cudnn_heuristics`、`cudnn_engines_runtime_compiled`

依赖关系（官方原文）：`cudnn_ops` 依赖 `cudnn_graph`；`cudnn_cnn` 依赖 `cudnn_ops` 与 `cudnn_graph`，且 `cudnn_cnn` 正常加载必须有 `cudnn_engines_precompiled`；`cudnn_adv` 依赖 `cudnn_ops` 与 `cudnn_graph`。

### 重要：传统卷积 API 已废弃
官方 Backend API Overview 将下列卷积入口列入 **cuDNN 9.0.0 Deprecated / Removed**：
- `cudnnConvolutionForward()`、`cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward()`
- `cudnnConvolutionBackwardData()`、`cudnnConvolutionBackwardFilter()`、`cudnnConvolutionBackwardBias()`
- 描述符：`cudnnCreateConvolutionDescriptor()`、`cudnnSetConvolution2dDescriptor()`、`cudnnSetConvolutionNdDescriptor()`、`cudnnSetConvolutionGroupCount()`、`cudnnSetConvolutionMathType()`、`cudnnSetConvolutionReorderType()`、`cudnnConvolutionDescriptor_t`、`cudnnConvolutionFwdAlgoPerf_t`
- 算法选择：`cudnnFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithm()`/`Ex()`、`cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm_v7()`、`cudnnGetConvolutionForwardWorkspaceSize()`、`cudnnGetConvolution2dForwardOutputDim()`

官方建议（原文）：
> "We recommend users to make API calls through the graph API, but the older shim layer (`libcudnn.so`) and legacy libraries (`libcudnn_cnn.so`, `libcudnn_ops.so`, `libcudnn_adv.so`) can still be directly used."

Graph API 页（原文）：
> "Use the cuDNN frontend to access the cuDNN Graph API unless you want to use legacy fixed-function routines or if you need a C-only graph API."

即：卷积推荐 **cuDNN Frontend（C++ header-only，包裹 backend graph API）**；官方仓库 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend 说明 FE "adds functionality on top of the backend API, like errata filters and autotuning"，且预期多数用户使用 FE API。C-only 场景可用 backend graph API（`cudnn-graph-library.html`）。

### 调用（两种路线）
1. **现代路线（cuDNN 9，推荐）**：用 cuDNN Frontend 构建运算图（conv forward + 可选 bias/pointwise），设置 `CUDNN_ATTR_ENGINE_*` 属性，选定 engine/plan 后执行。文档中给出的具体 API 入口之一是 backend native CUDA graph：`cudnnBackendPopulateCudaGraph()`、`cudnnBackendUpdateCudaGraph()`。
2. **传统路线（已 deprecated，仅旧代码/兼容用）**：`cudnnConvolutionForward`，其典型描述符与算法选择调用见上一节（均已废弃）：

## 六、选型流程（怎么选）

1. 是 **稠密矩阵乘** → cuBLAS；需要融合 epilogue / 更灵活布局 / batched 调优 → cuBLASLt `cublasLtMatmul`；大 batch / 小矩阵 → `cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx`。
2. 是 **卷积** → cuDNN；新代码用 cuDNN Frontend Graph API（cuDNN 9+），不要用已废弃的 `cudnnConvolutionForward`。
3. 是 **稀疏**（密度 <30%）→ cuSPARSE（SpMV/SpMM）；结构化稀疏 → cuSPARSELt。
4. 按数据类型/硬件核对：Tensor Core 需 CC ≥7.0；TF32 需 Ampere+；FP8 需 Hopper/Ada+；FP4 需 Blackwell。用 `cublasComputeType_t` / `cudnnSetConvolutionMathType` 显式控制。
5. 按 cuDNN Support Matrix 对齐 cuDNN ↔ CUDA Toolkit ↔ 驱动 ↔ GPU 架构。
